data.heading: Slow craft, for homes that tell a story
data.description:
Terra Market began in a small studio in Mattancherry, where we started selling pots made by our neighbours. Today we work with more than 40 independent makers across India: potters in Khurja, weavers in Kannur, brass-casters in Moradabad.

We pay fairly, order in small batches and never use plastic in our packaging.

data.heading: Our story
data.subheading: A small shop with a simple idea: beautiful everyday things, made by hand and sold fairly.

data.heading: From one studio to forty makers
data.description:
We started with a single shelf of pots in a Mattancherry courtyard. Visitors kept asking where they could buy more, so we began working with the potters, then the weavers down the road, then makers further afield.

Everything we sell is made in small batches. We visit our studios, agree prices together, and share the stories behind each piece.

data.heading: How can we help?
data.description: Still stuck? Write to us and we will reply within a working day.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Orders ship in 2–3 working days and usually arrive within 3–7 working days. You will receive a tracking number by email once your order ships.

items.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery is available across India for orders up to ₹10,000, with a small ₹49 handling fee. You can also pay online by UPI, card or net banking.

items.question: How much is delivery?
items.answer: Delivery is free on orders above ₹999. Below that, a flat ₹99 applies.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, within 7 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging. Write to us with your order number and we will arrange a pickup.

items.question: Will I get a GST invoice?
items.answer: Yes. A GST invoice is available on your order page as soon as the order is placed. Add your GSTIN at checkout for business purchases.

items.question: Why does my vase look slightly different from the photo?
items.answer: Every piece is handmade, so glaze and shape vary a little. We think that is what makes each one special.

data.heading: Need something else?
data.description: Our team is here Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 6 pm.

data.content:
Shipping

We ship across India. Orders are packed by hand and dispatched within 2–3 working days. Delivery takes 3–7 working days depending on your PIN code. Delivery is free on orders above ₹999; otherwise a flat ₹99 applies.

Cash on delivery

Available for orders up to ₹10,000 with a ₹49 handling fee.

Returns

You can return unused items in their original packaging within 7 days of delivery. Write to us with your order number; once we receive the item, we refund you within 5 working days to the original payment method (or by bank transfer for cash on delivery orders).

Damaged in transit

If anything arrives broken, send us a photo within 48 hours and we will replace it at no cost.

This policy explains how Terra Market collects and uses your information.

What we collect

When you order, we collect your name, email, phone number and delivery address so we can process and deliver your order. Payments are handled by our payment partner; we never see or store your card details.

How we use it

Only to fulfil your orders, send order updates and answer your questions. We do not sell your information.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on the contact page.

By placing an order on this website you agree to these terms.

Orders and prices

All prices are in Indian rupees and include GST. An order is confirmed once payment is received or, for cash on delivery, once you receive a confirmation email.

Handmade products

Our products are handmade; small variations in colour, size and finish are not defects.

Returns

See our Shipping & Returns page.
